decisions.reason: The lighting effect is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event.
The measurement-style units around the bowls are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event.
The general request for text and DJ-style details does not change the existing cursive K text, coverage, or color requirements.
The visual-design decision does not necessarily alter the BOM deliverable or any currently selected component.
The request to include logos and text like the CAD renderings does not specify a change to the already selected support-base logo treatment.
The request to include color reaffirms the visual direction but does not change the existing beige and green color values.
The general request for text and logos does not alter the placard wording, placement, duplication, or viewing orientations.
Decorative knobs and other DJ-style touches do not necessarily change the functional master power control or its location.
The visual emphasis on knobs does not specify any change to the established placement of speed, dispense, or master power controls.
Measurement markings around the bowls are decorative and do not change bowl capacity, depth, or enclosure-size constraints.
The source concerns visual character and decorative details, not the dispensing mechanism, sequence, flow, or operator behavior.
The visual-design modification does not change any splash-control target, constraint, or accepted mitigation.
